scope: Full-duration physical fields at common exact saved times; no temporal interpolation. Nested nodal grids use exact restriction; regular half-cell grids use degree8 spatial interpolation. AF node has zero radial norm weight and is not a physical metric sample. Field errors supplement all-stage safety and every-accepted-step constraints.
coverage_note: Only common reported-time matches within1e-10 are compared. Older cumulative-clock frames can miss a requested tick by one RK step; none are shifted or interpolated in time. The integer-step clock repair is a separate source-bound change.
